require "securerandom"

class RequestId
  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    request_id = env["HTTP_X_REQUEST_ID"] || SecureRandom.uuid
    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    headers["X-Request-Id"] = request_id
    [status, headers, body]
  end
end

- **Header value:** if the request already has an `X-Request-Id` header, the response reuses that value. Otherwise it uses a new random ID (a UUID).
- **To use it:** add `use RequestId` to your `config.ru`.
